title: Per-stage Linux-proxy cascade scoreboard — regression baseline for future waves
banner: NOT-CANONICAL / NOT-MAC. This scoreboard replays only the cascade stages runnable on Linux from COMMITTED artifacts. It is NOT the canonical n=5 strict cascade (pnpm lab:cascade over datasets/paddle-bench/runs/), which remains Mac-blocked per wave-e e06 (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: run dirs gitignored/absent, Apple-Vision pose macOS-only). Numbers here must NEVER be compared against the Mac north-star table in docs/STATUS_BOARD.md.
environment: Linux Ubuntu, Node 20.18.1, pnpm 10.15.1, ffmpeg 4.4.2, LINUX-CPU (no Apple Vision pose, no Mac, no iPhone)
groupingDiscipline: every stage groups by independent source session/clip; no random-frame splits anywhere; held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 never read by any stage

TARGET.reason: TA bench replay (pnpm lab:ta-bench run --all) requires datasets/corpus/runs/<recId>/people.json, which is gitignored and absent on Linux hosts. Probe run at head replayed 0/301 committed cases (n=0). The committed TA numbers in wave-c/wave-e artifacts were measured where corpus runs existed.
TARGET.coverage: 0/301 committed TA cases replayable from committed artifacts

EVENT.coverage: 16 DEV gold target events across 10 cases with committed wrist signal (wave-a windowed people.json + W6 rally1 replay fixture); canonical 5-case bench events NOT covered (no committed pose except rally1 fixture)
EVENT.waveEReference: e01 after: 12/16 recall, mean overlap .839, 0 false proposals
EVENT.verdict: NO_DRIFT — byte-level agreement with e01 after-state

OWNERSHIP.coverage: corrected: 39 dual frames (18 with committed pose) across 8 cases / 5 source sessions; incumbent wrist-ratio heuristic only replayable on the 18-frame pose subset; canonical 5-case bench frames have NO committed pose (labels-only methods there)
OWNERSHIP.waveEReference: e05 after: 39 dual frames / 18 with pose, incumbent pose-subset 0.722

PADDLE.reason: Paddle bench and cascade PADDLE stage read runs/<case>/report.json + debug.json paddle tracks under datasets/paddle-bench/runs/ (gitignored, Mac-only; e06 forensics). No committed paddle tracks exist for the wave-a bundles either.

BALL.harness: packages/swing-lab/src/ballHardSliceEval.ts (wave-e e12 / D2-06, unmodified) — REAL tracker (buildBallTracks → selectPrimaryBallTrack) over committed Linux-regenerated motion candidates
BALL.coverage: 43 D2-06 hard-slice gold labels (35 OBSERVED / 3 ENTERING_OCCLUSION / 2 OCCLUDED / 1 REACQUIRED / 2 uncertain-excluded); pose-free proxy — the play-band gate is inert (no pose on Linux); NOT the canonical BALL stage criterion
BALL.waveEReference: e12 after: identical per-bucket aggregate (OBSERVED 4/35 hits, 11 miss, 20 wrongLoc; 2 OCCLUDED violations)
BALL.verdict: NO_DRIFT — matches e12 after-state exactly (hard-slice weakness and occlusion violations remain open findings, not regressions)

CONTACT.harness: packages/vision-geometry/eval/contactGoldReplay.ts via datasets/experiments/wave-f/f16-contact-replay-run.ts (assertion-free wrapper; replay logic unmodified). Condition: committed runs-wave-a pose, ORACLE ball (gold frames, conf 0.9 — measures temporal fusion, NOT the ball tracker), paddle track ABSENT.
CONTACT.coverage: 10 non-held-out gold target contact events (plus other-owner rows) across 4 sessions; oracle-ball condition only
CONTACT.waveEReference: e02 committed artifact (commit f2dedf7): 6/10 estimated, 0 wrong markers, median 17ms, p90 65ms
CONTACT.verdict: DRIFT_FOUND — see driftFinding; the committed e02 eval suite now FAILS at integration head

driftFinding.symptom: wavea-sasebo-volleys gold target contact @52019 (volley): e02 state was errorMs 16 at conf 0.70 with ballConfirmed=true; head state is errorMs 144 at conf 0.79 with ballConfirmed=false (ball evidence gone, wrist peak @51875 wins). 144 > 132 acceptable ⇒ high-confidence wrong marker, which violates the e02 eval invariant (pnpm --filter @pickle/vision-geometry eval fails at head: 'expected 144 to be less than or equal to 132').
driftFinding.evidence: harness and gold unchanged since e02 (git log f2dedf7..HEAD on eval/contactGoldReplay.ts is empty; same 10 gold target events); the only estimateContact source change in that range is e09 commit f3a0e63 'gap-edge censoring + paddle reach tether (contact-evidence-4.2)' merged at d46e7d8 AFTER e02's artifact was recorded. e09 validated on synthetic adversarial fixtures only; this committed-gold row was never re-replayed post-merge until now.
driftFinding.interpretation: PLAUSIBLE root cause (inference, not proven line-level): e09's gap-edge censoring censors the ball direction-change/proximity evidence near the occlusion gap around 52019, removing the anchor that made e02's estimate correct; coverage simultaneously rose 6→7 estimated. Both e02 and e09 shipped as 'contact-evidence-4.2' without bumping the version against each other, so the version string cannot distinguish the two behaviors.
driftFinding.disposition: Recorded as a regression finding for the integrator (f16 is read-only on production code). Candidate fixes: re-tune censoring on committed gold, or version-split the estimator (4.3) with the invariant restored.

PHASE.harness: datasets/experiments/wave-d3/d3-05-measure-gold.ts (unmodified) — segmentPhasesTemporalV2 on committed wave-a event-bounds gold
PHASE.coverage: 18 anchor-free-eligible / 17 anchored gold labels across 8 dev bundles; abstention reasons preserved

STROKE.harness: packages/swing-lab/src/strokeHeuristicBench.ts (wave-e e03, unmodified) via datasets/experiments/wave-f/f16-stroke-bench-run.ts (persists the full report)
STROKE.coverage: 18/29 committed stroke gold labels evaluable (11 unevaluable: no committed pose), 4 source-session groups
STROKE.waveEReference: e03 candidate stroke-heuristic-4: identical (9/0/8 L1, 4/3/4 L2, conf-wrong 3)

scoreboardSummary.stagesRunnable: 5 of 7 cascade stages have an honest Linux proxy (EVENT, OWNERSHIP, BALL, CONTACT, PHASE, STROKE — 6 harnesses over 5 cascade positions; TARGET and PADDLE have none)
driftFound: CONTACT — 1 new high-confidence wrong marker (144ms @ conf 0.79) on committed gold, introduced between e02's artifact commit and integration head; e02 eval suite fails at head

limits: None of these numbers are cascade north stars: denominators, conditions, and criteria differ per stage (oracle ball for CONTACT, pose-free tracker for BALL, pose-subset for OWNERSHIP incumbent).

Cross-stage conditioning (the strict-survival waterfall) is NOT measured — each stage is replayed independently on its own committed inputs, unlike the canonical cascade where each stage consumes upstream outputs.
The label-blind fresh-candidate pool and held-out cases are untouched.
Future waves should treat stage-level metric changes vs THIS artifact (same commands, same committed data) as regressions; comparisons against Mac numbers remain invalid.
